title: Funny Pickleball Shirt, Just One More Game Pickleball Clock, I Said That 4 Hours Ago, Gift for Players
description:
'Just one more game' is the most famous lie in pickleball. The clock says it has been four hours.

Who it's for:
- Players who always stay for one more
- Partners waiting in the car
- Gift givers for the friend who can't leave the court

About the design:
A lime ball-clock with cut-out hands sits under big, readable lettering. The punchline is larger than before so it reads on a phone.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Just One More Game design with a lime pickleball clock on a black tee.
